H4200.et: probably from an unused root meaning to gather in
H4200.def: probably from an unused root meaning to gather in; a granary:--garner.

H4201.def: or mzuzah {mez-oo-zaw'}; from the same as «02123»; a door-post (as prominent):--(door, side) post.

H4204.et: from (02114) in the sense of turning aside from truth
H4204.def: from «02114» in the sense of turning aside from truth; treachery, i.e. a plot:--wound.

H4205.et: from (02115) in the sense of binding
H4205.def: or mazor {maw-zore'}; from «02115» in the sense of binding up; a bandage, i.e. remedy; hence, a sore (as needing a compress):--bound up, wound.

H4206.def: or mezach {may-zakh'}; from «02118»; a belt (as movable):--girdle, strength.

H4207.et: from an unused root meaning to draw up
H4207.def: or (feminine) mizlagah {miz-law-gaw'}; from an unused root meaning to draw up; a fork:--fleshhook.

H4208.et: apparently from (05140) in the sense of raining
H4208.def: apparently from «05140» in the sense of raining; a constellation, i.e. Zodiacal sign (perhaps as affecting the weather):--planet. Compare «04216».

H4209.def: from «02161»; a plan, usually evil (machination), sometimes good (sagacity):--(wicked) device, discretion, intent, witty invention, lewdness, mischievous (device), thought, wickedly.

H4210.def: from «02167»; properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes:--psalm.

H4212.def: from «02168»; a tweezer (only in the plural):--snuffers.

H4213.def: from the same as «02191»; fewness; by implication, as superl. diminutiveness:--few, × very.

H4214.def: from «02219»; a winnowing shovel (as scattering the chaff):--fan.

H4215.def: apparently from «02219»; properly, a scatterer, i.e. the north wind (as dispersing clouds; only in plural):--north.

H4216.et: apparently from (05144) in the sense of distinction
H4216.def: apparently from «05144» in the sense of distinction; some noted constellation (only in the plural), perhaps collectively, the zodiac:--Mazzoroth. Compare «04208».

H4217.def: from «02224»; sunrise, i.e. the east:--east (side, -ward), (sun-)rising (of the sun).

H4219.def: from «02236»; a bowl (as if for sprinkling):--bason, bowl.

H4220.et: from (04229) in the sense of greasing
H4220.def: from «04229» in the sense of greasing; fat; figuratively, rich:--fatling (one).

H4221.def: from the same as «04220»; fat, i.e. marrow:--marrow.

H4222.def: a primitive root; to rub or strike the hands together (in exultation):--clap.

H4223.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «04222»; to strike in pieces; also to arrest; specifically to impale:--hang, smite, stay.

H4224.def: or machaboo {makh-ab-o'}; from «02244»; a refuge:--hiding (lurking) place.

H4225.def: from «02266»; a junction, i.e. seam or sewed piece:--coupling.

H4226.def: from «02266»; a joiner, i.e. brace or cramp:--coupling, joining.

H4227.def: from the same as «02281»; a pan for baking in:--pan.

H4229.def: a primitive root; properly, to stroke or rub; by implication, to erase; also to smooth (as if with oil), i.e. grease or make fat; also to touch, i.e. reach to:--abolish, blot out, destroy, full of marrow, put out, reach unto, × utterly, wipe (away, out).

H4230.def: from «02328»; an instrument for marking a circle, i.e. compasses:--compass.

H4231.et: from an unused root meaning to enclose
H4231.def: from an unused root meaning to enclose; a harbor (as shut in by the shore):--haven.

H4232.def: or Mchiyyauel {mekh-ee-yaw-ale'}; from «04229» and «0410»; smitten of God; Mechujael or Mechijael, an anxediluvian patriarch:--Mehujael.

H4233.et: apparently a patrial, but from an unknown place (in the pl. only for a sing.)
H4233.def: apparently a patrial, but from an unknown place (in the plural only for a singular); a Machavite or inhabitant of some place named Machaveh:--Mahavite.

H4235.def: the same as «04234»; dancing; Machol, an Israelite:--Mahol.

H4238.def: feminine plural from «02372»; visions; Machazioth, an Israelite:--Mahazioth.

H4240.def: from «02330»; junction; Mechida, one of the Nethinim:--Mehida.

H4241.def: from «02421»; preservation of life; hence, sustenance; also the live flesh, i.e. the quick:--preserve life, quick, recover selves, reviving, sustenance, victuals.

H4242.et: from an unused root meaning to buy
H4242.def: from an unused root meaning to buy; price, payment, wages:--gain, hire, price, sold, worth.

H4243.def: the same as «04242»; price; Mechir, an Israelite:--Mehir.

H4244.def: from «02470»; sickness; Machlah, the name apparently of two Israelitesses:--Mahlah.

H4245.def: or (feminine) machalah {makk-al-aw'}; from «02470»; sickness:--disease, infirmity, sickness.

H4249.def: from «02470»; sick; Machli, the name of two Israelites:--Mahli.

H4250.def: patronymical from «04249»; a Machlite or (collectively) descendants of Machli:--Mahlites.

H4252.def: from «02498»; a (sacrificial) knife (as gliding through the flesh):--knife.

H4253.def: from «02498»; a ringlet of hair (as gliding over each other):--lock.

H4254.def: from «02502»; a mantle (as easily drawn off):--changeable suit of apparel, change of raiment.

H4255.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «04256»; a section (of the Levites):--course.

H4256.def: from «02505»; a section (of Levites, people or soldiers):--company, course, division, portion. See also «05555».

H4257.def: from «02470»; sickness; Machalath, probably the title (initial word) of a popular song:--Mahalath.

H4258.def: the same as «04257»; sickness; Machalath, the name of an Ishmaelitess and of an Israelitess:--Mahalath.

H4259.def: patrial from «065»; a Mecholathite or inhabitant of Abel-Mecholah:--Mecholathite.

H4260.def: a denominative from «02529»; something buttery (i.e. unctuous and pleasant), as (figuratively) flattery:--X than butter.

H4261.def: from «02530»; delightful; hence, a delight, i.e. object of affection or desire:--beloved, desire, goodly, lovely, pleasant (thing).

H4262.def: or machmuwd {makh-mood'}; from «02530»; desired; hence, a valuable:--pleasant thing.

H4263.def: from «02550»; properly, sympathy; (by paronomasia with «04261») delight:--pitieth.

H4264.def: from «02583»; an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence, an army, whether literal (of soldiers) or figurative (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts):-- army, band, battle, camp, company, drove, host, tents.

H4265.def: from «04264» and «01835»; camp of Dan; Machaneh-Dan, a place in Palestine:--Mahaneh-dan.

H4266.def: dual of «04264»; double camp; Machanajim, a place in Palestine:--Mahanaim.

H4268.def: or machceh {makh-seh'}; from «02620»; a shelter (literally or figuratively):--hope, (place of) refuge, shelter, trust.

H4270.def: or machcor {makh-sore'}; from «02637»; deficiency; hence, impoverishment:--lack, need, penury, poor, poverty, want.

H4271.def: from «04268» and «03050»; refuge of (i.e. in) Jah; Machsejah, an Israelite:--Maaseiah.

H4272.def: a primitive root; to dash asunder; by implication, to crush, smash or violently plunge; figuratively, to subdue or destroy:--dip, pierce (through), smite (through), strike through, wound.

H4274.def: from «02672»; properly, a hewing; concretely, a quarry:--hewed(-n).

H4276.def: from «02673»; a halving or the middle:--half (so much), mid(-day).

H4277.def: a primitive root; to crush:--smite off.

H4278.def: from «02713»; properly, scrutinized, i.e. (by implication) a recess:--deep place.

H4279.def: probably from «0309»; properly, deferred, i.e. the morrow; usually (adverbially) tomorrow; indefinitely, hereafter:--time to come, tomorrow.

H4280.def: from the same as «02716»; a sink:--draught house.

H4283.def: or mochoratham (1 Sam. 30:17) {mokh-or-aw- thawm'}; feminine from the same as «04279»; the morrow or (adverbially) tomorrow:--morrow, next day.

H4284.def: or machashebeth {makh-ash-eh'-beth}; from «02803»; a contrivance, i.e. (concretely) a texture, machine, or (abstractly) intention, plan (whether bad, a plot; or good, advice):--cunning (work), curious work, device(-sed), imagination, invented, means, purpose, thought.

H4285.def: from «02821»; darkness; concretely, a dark place:--dark(-ness, place).

H4287.def: probably from «04229»; erasure; Machath, the name of two Israelites:--Mahath.

H4288.def: from «02846»; properly, a dissolution; concretely, a ruin, or (abstractly) consternation:--destruction, dismaying, ruin, terror.

H4289.et: the same as (04288) in the sense of removal
H4289.def: the same as «04288» in the sense of removal; a pan for live coals:--censer, firepan, snuffdish.

H4290.def: from «02864»; a burglary; figuratively, unexpected examination:--breaking up, secret search.

H4291.et: apparently corresponding to (04672) in the intransitive sense of being found present
H4291.def: (Aramaic) or mtah (Aramaic) {met-aw'}; apparently corresponding to «04672» in the intransitive sense of being found present; to arrive, extend or happen:--come, reach.

H4292.def: apparently a denominative from «02916»; a broom (as removing dirt (compare Engl. "to dust", i.e. remove dust)):--besom.

H4294.def: or (feminine) mattah {mat-taw'}; from «05186»; a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively, a support of life, e.g. bread):--rod, staff, tribe.

H4295.def: from «05786» with directive enclitic appended; downward, below or beneath; often adverbially with or without prefixes:-- beneath, down(-ward), less, very low, under(-neath).

H4296.def: from «05186»; a bed (as extended) for sleeping or eating; by analogy, a sofa, litter or bier:--bed((-chamber)), bier.

H4297.def: from «05186»; a stretching, i.e. distortion (figuratively, iniquity):--perverseness.
